acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a task and a step, When nit explain-routing runs, Then it prints the full composition chain — base, language, custom, step-scoped and global — showing which layer contributed each skill and which were dropped as absent.
Given a task, When nit resolve-routing runs, Then it writes a schema-valid routing.json for that task's current step and exits 0.
Given a task whose module is not in the registry, When either command runs, Then it fails naming the module and pointing at modules.json rather than resolving a partial chain.
